_about: Q-CLOSURE (coordinator ruling 2026-11-21). WRITTEN by app/src/components/chart/engine/ast/htfSessionWeek.test.js (HTF_SESSION_WEEK_WRITE=1), READ by it and by tests/test_pine_htf_session_week.py. `sets`: SYNTHETIC daily bars shaped like the captures vw-req-w-closure-day-{eurusd,es1}-1d-2026-11-20 (bar i: o = i + 0.5, h = i + 1.5, l = i, c = i + 1, v = 100 + i), dated by the calendar date of each session's open, plus controls of other shapes; `keying`: this lane's barDays for each set. Per case: `tree`, `opts` (JS spelling), `pick` (bar indexes), `expect` (the hand-written answer, null = withheld), `served` (this lane's whole column), `codes` (what it named). The Python lane (ast_interpret) must equal all of them.
